name: Diwali Season & Cosmic Science
description: Festive Diwali celebrations, Ramayana folklore, Govardhan nature gratitude, Bhai Dooj sibling bonds, and World Science Day deep-sea & astronomy explainers.

reels.caption:

reels.title: Diwali Special: The Potter's Humble Diya
reels.hook: Why did Lord Rama reject golden platters for a poor potter's clay lamp?
reels.concept: When Ayodhya was bathed in gold, Lord Rama visited a weeping potter's hut to light his clay diya, teaching that love outshines gold.
reels.caption:
🪔 सोने के थाल छोड़, प्रभु श्री राम ने कुम्हार का दीया क्यों थामा? ✨

रोशनी सोने से नहीं, प्रेम और सच्ची भक्ति से होती है। शुभ दीपावली! 🪔✨

#happydiwali #diwali2026 #ayodhya #shriram #rammandir #stickmananimation #festivevibes

reels.title: Govardhan: The Mountain on a Little Finger
reels.hook: 7 days of torrential thunderstorms. One little finger held the sky.
reels.concept: The legendary tale of lifting Mount Govardhan to shelter a flooded village, demonstrating nature reverence over arrogant power.
reels.caption:
⛰️ 7 DAYS OF RAIN. ONE LITTLE FINGER HELD THE SKY. 🌧️✨

Happy Govardhan Puja to you and your family! 🙏🪔

reels.hook: Even the God of Death must put down his noose on Bhai Dooj.

reels.hook: More people have walked on the Moon than stood at the bottom of our ocean.

reels.title: The Blind Astronomer of Ancient Ujjain
reels.hook: 1,500 years before NASA, he calculated the exact orbit of Mars with sticks and sand.
reels.concept: Aryabhata and Varahamihira's astronomical breakthroughs in ancient India: calculating earth's circumference and zero.
reels.caption:
🔭 1,500 YEARS BEFORE NASA, HE CALCULATED MARS' ORBIT 🌌📜

The incredible scientific heritage of ancient India.
